text:
Mia Rivera: Heads up — exec at Telaro pressed for a formal SLA commitment for the POC; they want 99.9% and <100ms p95 for realtime inference by EOD tomorrow. Can we confirm feasibility? cc @Omar Khan @Jess Park

Omar Khan: Copying infra + SE. 100ms p95 for what payload size? small prompts or 2k tokens?

Jess Park: Telaro demo uses short prompts (~200 tokens) and streaming websocket. They've emphasized cost predictability too.

Patrick O'Neill: 99.9% is tough for a POC on shared capacity. Dedicated pool with reserved nodes + health checks could work. Need approval from sales for the cost delta.

Li Chen: Product note — we have a temporary fallback plan: route to a smaller model with graceful degradation if latency spikes. But the SLA ask is for the trial environment too?

Mia Rivera: They want it for the trial run — execs said they'd sign on that basis. Risk: Legal will want indemnities and carveouts.

Jess Park: @Patrick can you run a quick capacity check on dedicated 4xA10g? Also need a sample SLO doc snippet I can send to the customer.

Patrick O'Neill: Running perf tests now. ETA ~45m. Preliminary: with batching disabled and websocket pinned, p95 ≈ 95ms for 200-token gen on 4xA10g, but 99.9% availability depends on infra failover and warmup.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: new test run queued on pool 'telaro-probe-v2' — job id 77432

Mia Rivera: Great. Jess, start drafting the SLA email with these caveats. Include fallback model and canary rollout language. I'll loop in Legal afterwards.

Jess Park: Drafted, here's snippet:

```
SLA: 99.9% uptime during scheduled POC window
Latency: p95 < 100ms for 0-250 token requests
Fallback: automatic routing to smaller model if p95 > 120ms for >5m
```

Thoughts?

Omar Khan: Add: 'service-level objective applies to host-level availability; does not cover customer-side network issues' — standard clause.

Li Chen: Also add telemetry requirements: they need to run a synthetic probe every minute and share logs with our ops team during the POC.

Mia Rivera: Ok finalize and send to @Legal-Sales (I'll ping legal). Patrick, if tests show tail risk, can you propose mitigation (reserved hot standby + cross-region failover)?

Patrick O'Neill: Will propose standby + small autoscale buffer. If Legal ok, we can commit for the POC only and migrate SLA into the paid contract with stricter terms.

Jess Park: Sending draft to Mia for review.

deploy-bot: reaction :eyes:

Mia Rivera: Thanks all. I'll update thread after Legal chimes in. If we can lock this, schedule exec briefing right after the demo tomorrow morning.
